stemMarkdown: What is the combined defect rate (%) across both factories? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Defective units: Factory A $= 1200 \times 0.025 = 30$, Factory B $= 800 \times 0.04 = 32$. Total defective $= 62$, total units $= 2000$. Combined defect rate $= 62/2000 \times 100 = 3.1\%$ — **not** the simple average of 2.5% and 4.0% (3.25%), because the two factories produce different volumes.
